title.zh: 卷七十四 志第二十五: 祭祀三
title.raw: 卷七十四 志第二十五: 祭祀三 Volume 74 Treatises 27: Offerings 3

sentences.zh: 祭祀三 ○宗廟上

translations.literal: Offerings 3 ○ Ancestral Temples, Upper Section
translations.idiomatic: Offerings, Part Three — Ancestral Temples (Upper Section)

sentences.zh: 至元元年冬十月，奉安神主於太廟，初定太廟七室之制。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter in the first year of Zhiyuan, the spirit tablets were installed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and for the first time the system of seven chambers of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter of Zhiyuan 1, the spirit tablets were installed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and the temple's seven-chamber layout was established for the first time.

sentences.zh: 皇祖、皇祖妣第一室，皇伯考、伯妣第二室，皇考、皇妣第三室，皇伯考、伯妣第四室，皇伯考、伯妣第五室，皇兄、皇后第六室，皇兄、皇后第七室。

translations.literal: The first chamber was for the imperial grandfather and imperial grandmother; the second for the imperial father's elder brother and his wife; the third for the imperial father and imperial mother; the fourth for the imperial father's elder brother and his wife; the fifth for the imperial father's elder brother and his wife; the sixth for the imperial elder brother and empress; the seventh for the imperial elder brother and empress.
translations.idiomatic: The first chamber was assigned to the imperial grandfather and grandmother; the second to an imperial grand-uncle and his consort; the third to the imperial father and mother; the fourth and fifth likewise to imperial grand-uncles and their consorts; and the sixth and seventh to imperial elder brothers and their empresses.

sentences.zh: 凡室以西為上，以次而東。

translations.literal: In all chambers, the west was regarded as superior, proceeding eastward in order.
translations.idiomatic: Within each chamber, precedence ran from west to east.

sentences.zh: 二年九月，初命滌養犧牲，取大樂工於東平，習禮儀。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year, for the first time orders were issued to cleanse and rear sacrificial animals, to recruit great music masters from Dongping, and to practice ritual ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 2, the court for the first time ordered sacrificial animals cleansed and reared, brought in master musicians from Dongping, and had them rehearse the ritual observances.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，享於太廟，尊皇祖為太祖。

translations.literal: On the day jimao in the tenth month of winter, an offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and the imperial grandfather was honored as Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the tenth winter month, a temple offering was held, and the imperial grandfather was posthumously honored as Taizu (Founding Ancestor).

sentences.zh: 三年秋九月，始作八室神主，設祏室。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn in the third year, eight-chamber spirit tablets were first made, and a shrine for distant ancestors was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn of year 3, spirit tablets for eight chambers were first fashioned and a side shrine for collateral ancestors was set up.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，太廟成。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed.

sentences.zh: 丞相安童、伯顏言：「祖宗世數、尊謚廟號、配享功臣、增祀四世、各廟神主、七祀神位、法服祭器等事，皆宜以時定」。

translations.literal: The chief councillors Antong and Bayan said: "The generations of ancestors and forebears, posthumous titles and temple names, meritorious ministers in paired offerings, the addition of sacrifices for four generations, the spirit tablets of each temple, the spirit seats of the seven sacrifices, ritual garments, sacrificial vessels, and other matters should all be settled in due season."
translations.idiomatic: Chief Councillors Antong and Bayan submitted that the ordering of ancestral generations, posthumous titles and temple names, ministers to share in the offerings, the extension of worship to four additional generations, the spirit tablets for each shrine, the seats for the seven sacrifices, ritual vestments, sacrificial implements, and related matters should all be fixed at the proper time.

sentences.zh: 乃命平章政事趙璧等集議，制尊謚廟號，定為八室。

translations.literal: Thereupon the emperor ordered the associate chief councillor Zhao Bi and others to assemble for deliberation, to establish posthumous titles and temple names, and to fix the arrangement as eight chambers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then ordered Associate Chief Councillor Zhao Bi and others to deliberate together, establish posthumous titles and temple names, and fix the temple at eight chambers.

sentences.zh: 烈祖神元皇帝、皇曾祖妣宣懿皇后第一室，太祖聖武皇帝、皇祖妣光獻皇后第二室，太宗英文皇帝、皇伯妣昭慈皇后第三室，皇伯考術赤、皇伯妣別土出迷失第四室，皇伯考察合帶、皇伯妣也速倫第五室，皇考睿宗景襄皇帝、皇妣莊聖皇后第六室，定宗簡平皇帝、欽淑皇后第七室，憲宗桓肅皇帝、貞節皇后第八室。

translations.literal: The first chamber: Liezu, the Divine Origin Emperor, and the imperial great-grandmother, Empress Xuanyi; the second chamber: Taizu, the Sagely Martial Emperor, and the imperial grandmother, Empress Guangxian; the third chamber: Taizong, the Cultured and Martial Emperor, and the imperial grand-aunt, Empress Zhaoci; the fourth chamber: the imperial grand-uncle Jochi and the imperial grand-aunt Botu Chumishi; the fifth chamber: the imperial grand-uncle Chagatai and the imperial grand-aunt Yesulun; the sixth chamber: the imperial father, Emperor Ruizong Jingxiang, and the imperial mother, Empress Zhuangsheng; the seventh chamber: Emperor Dingzong Jianping and Empress Qinshu; the eighth chamber: Emperor Xianzong Huansu and Empress Zhenjie.
translations.idiomatic: The first chamber was dedicated to Liezu, the Divine Origin Emperor, with the imperial great-grandmother Empress Xuanyi; the second to Taizu, the Sagely Martial Emperor, with Empress Guangxian; the third to Taizong, the Cultured and Martial Emperor, with Empress Zhaoci; the fourth to the imperial grand-uncle Jochi and his consort Botu Chumishi; the fifth to the grand-uncle Chagatai and Yesulun; the sixth to the imperial father, Emperor Ruizong Jingxiang, and Empress Zhuangsheng; the seventh to Emperor Dingzong Jianping and Empress Qinshu; and the eighth to Emperor Xianzong Huansu and Empress Zhenjie.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申，奉安神主於祏室，歲用冬祀，如初禮。

translations.literal: On the day wushen in the eleventh month, the spirit tablets were installed in the collateral shrine; each year the winter sacrifice was used, as in the initial rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the eleventh month, the spirit tablets were installed in the collateral shrine, and the winter sacrifice was thereafter observed each year according to the original rites.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，初定一歲十二月薦新時物。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year, for the first time the seasonal offerings of fresh produce for the twelve months of the year were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 4, the seasonal fresh offerings for each of the twelve months were first established.

sentences.zh: 六年冬，時享畢，十二月，命國師僧薦佛事於太廟七晝夜，始造木質金表牌位十有六，設大榻金椅奉安祏室前，為太廟薦佛事之始。

translations.literal: In the winter of the sixth year, when the seasonal offering was completed, in the twelfth month the emperor ordered the state preceptor monks to perform Buddhist services at the Imperial Ancestral Temple for seven days and nights; for the first time sixteen wooden plaques with gilded inscriptions were made, and a great couch with golden chairs was set up before the collateral shrine for their installation—this was the beginning of Buddhist services at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of year 6, after the seasonal offering was finished, in the twelfth month the court ordered state-preceptor monks to perform Buddhist rites at the Imperial Ancestral Temple for seven days and nights. Sixteen wooden plaques with gilded faces were made for the first time, and a great couch with golden chairs was placed before the collateral shrine to receive them—marking the beginning of Buddhist observances at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 七年十月癸酉，敕宗廟祝文書以國字。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou in the tenth month of the seventh year, an edict ordered that prayer texts for the ancestral temple be written in the national script.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the tenth month of year 7, an edict directed that temple prayer texts be written in the Mongol script.

sentences.zh: 八年八月，太廟柱朽，從張易言，告於列室而後修，奉遷栗主金牌位與舊神主於饌幕殿，工畢安奉。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the eighth year, the pillars of the Imperial Ancestral Temple rotted; following Zhang Yi's advice, announcement was made to each chamber before repairs began; the wooden spirit tablets, gold plaque tablets, and old spirit tablets were reverently moved to the Feast Pavilion Hall, and when the work was finished they were reinstalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 8 the pillars of the Imperial Ancestral Temple had decayed. Following Zhang Yi's counsel, each chamber was notified before repairs began; the wooden tablets, gilded plaque tablets, and older spirit tablets were reverently moved to the Feast Pavilion Hall and, when the work was done, reinstalled.

sentences.zh: 自是修廟皆如之。

translations.literal: From this time onward, all temple repairs followed this practice.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth every temple repair followed the same procedure.

sentences.zh: 丙子，敕冬享毋用犧牛。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, an edict ordered that sacrificial oxen not be used for the winter offering.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day an edict forbade the use of sacrificial oxen at the winter temple offering.

sentences.zh: 十二年五月，檢討張謙呈：「昔者因修太廟，奉遷金牌位於饌幕殿，設以金椅，其栗主卻與舊主牌位各貯箱內，安置金椅下，禮有非宜。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twelfth year, Reviewer Zhang Qian submitted: "Formerly, because the Imperial Ancestral Temple was being repaired, the gold plaque tablets were reverently moved to the Feast Pavilion Hall and set upon golden chairs, yet the wooden spirit tablets together with the old spirit tablets and name plaques were each stored in boxes and placed beneath the golden chairs—this was ritually improper."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 12, Reviewer Zhang Qian submitted: "When the Imperial Ancestral Temple was repaired in the past, the gilded plaque tablets were moved to the Feast Pavilion Hall and set on golden chairs, while the wooden tablets and older tablets with their name plaques were packed in boxes and placed under those chairs—an arrangement at odds with proper ritual."

sentences.zh: 今擬合以金牌位遷於八室內，其祏室栗主宜用彩輿遷納，舊主並牌位安置於箱為宜。

translations.literal: It is now proposed that the gold plaque tablets be moved into the eight chambers, that the wooden tablets of the collateral shrine should be moved in by colored palanquins, and that the old tablets together with the name plaques should be stored in boxes as appropriate."
translations.idiomatic: We now propose moving the gilded plaque tablets into the eight chambers, conveying the collateral shrine's wooden tablets in decorated palanquins, and keeping the older tablets and name plaques in storage boxes as appropriate."

sentences.zh: 」九月丁丑，敕太廟牲復用牛。

translations.literal: " In the ninth month, on the day dingchou, an edict ordered that sacrificial oxen again be used at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: " In the ninth month, on the dingchou day, an edict restored the use of sacrificial oxen at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 十月己未，遷金牌位於八室內。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei in the tenth month, the gold plaque tablets were moved into the eight chambers.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the tenth month, the gilded plaque tablets were moved into the eight chambers.

sentences.zh: 太祝兼奉禮郎申屠致遠言：「竊見木主既成，又有金牌位，其日月山神主及中統初中書設祭神主，安奉無所。

translations.literal: The Grand Invoker and Concurrent Ritual Officer Shentu Zhiyuan said: "I have observed that once the wooden spirit tablets were completed, there were also gold plaque tablets; the spirit tablets for the Sun, Moon, and Mountains, and the spirit tablets set up for sacrifice by the Secretariat in the early Zhongtong period, have no place for installation."
translations.idiomatic: Grand Invoker and Concurrent Ritual Officer Shentu Zhiyuan said: "Once the wooden spirit tablets were in place, gilded plaque tablets were added as well; yet the tablets for the Sun, Moon, and Mountains, and those the Secretariat had set up for sacrifice early in the Zhongtong era, still have nowhere fitting to be installed."

sentences.zh: 」博士議曰：「合存祏室栗主，舊置神主牌位，俱可隨時埋瘞，不致神有二歸。

translations.literal: " The erudites deliberated and said: "The wooden tablets kept in the collateral shrine and the old spirit tablets and name plaques may all be buried at the appropriate time, so that the spirits do not have two resting places."
translations.idiomatic: " The ritual erudites ruled: "The wooden tablets kept in the collateral shrine, together with the older spirit tablets and name plaques, may all be buried when appropriate, lest a spirit be given two abodes."

sentences.zh: 」太常少卿以聞，制曰：「其與張仲謙諸老臣議行之。

translations.literal: " The Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported this, and the emperor decreed: "Let this be deliberated and carried out with Zhang Zhongqian and the other senior ministers."
translations.idiomatic: " The Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported the matter, and the emperor decreed: "Have Zhang Zhongqian and the other senior ministers deliberate and implement it."

sentences.zh: 」十三年九月丙申，薦佛事於太廟，命即佛事處便大祭。

translations.literal: " In the ninth month of the thirteenth year, on the day bingshen, Buddhist services were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and the emperor ordered that a great sacrifice be held on the spot where the Buddhist rites took place.
translations.idiomatic: " In the ninth month of year 13, on the bingshen day, Buddhist rites were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and the emperor ordered a great sacrifice held at the very site of those rites.

sentences.zh: 己亥，享於太廟，加薦羊鹿野豕。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, an offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, with the addition of sheep, deer, and wild boar as offerings.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day a temple offering was held, with supplementary offerings of sheep, deer, and wild boar.

sentences.zh: 是歲，改作金主，太祖主題曰「成吉思皇帝」，睿宗題曰「太上皇也可那顏」，皇后皆題名諱。

translations.literal: In that year, new gold spirit tablets were made; Taizu's tablet was inscribed "Emperor Chinggis," Ruizong's tablet was inscribed "Supreme Emperor and Yeke Noyan," and all empresses' tablets bore their taboo personal names.
translations.idiomatic: That year new gilded spirit tablets were cast: Taizu's was inscribed "Emperor Chinggis," Ruizong's "Supreme Emperor and Yeke Noyan," and each empress's tablet bore her taboo personal name.

sentences.zh: 十四年八月乙丑，詔建太廟於大都。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourteenth year, on the day yichou, an edict ordered that the Imperial Ancestral Temple be built at Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 14, on the yichou day, an edict ordered construction of the Imperial Ancestral Temple at Dadu.

sentences.zh: 博士言：「古者廟制率都宮別殿，西漢亦各立廟，東都以中興崇儉，故七室同堂，後世遂不能革。

translations.literal: The erudites said: "In antiquity the temple system generally followed the pattern of a central palace with separate halls; the Western Han also established separate temples for each ancestor. The Eastern Capital, because it revived the dynasty while honoring frugality, therefore had seven chambers under one roof, and later ages could not reform this."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual erudites observed: "Ancient temple arrangements typically placed each shrine in its own hall within a larger precinct; the Western Han likewise built separate temples. Because the Eastern Capital dynasty rose through restoration while preaching austerity, its seven ancestral chambers shared one hall—a precedent later ages found impossible to overturn."

sentences.zh: 」十五年五月九日，太常卿還自上都，為議廟制，據博士言同堂異室非禮，以古今廟制畫圖貼說，令博士李天麟賫往上都，分議可否以聞。

translations.literal: " On the ninth day of the fifth month of the fifteenth year, the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices returned from the Upper Capital to deliberate on the temple system; relying on the erudites' statement that separate chambers under one roof was not ritual, he prepared illustrated explanations of temple systems ancient and modern, and ordered the erudite Li Tianlin to carry them to the Upper Capital so that deliberation on what was feasible might be reported.
translations.idiomatic: " On the ninth day of the fifth month of year 15 the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices returned from Shangdu to debate the temple layout. Citing the erudites' view that a single hall with separate chambers was unorthodox, he prepared illustrated comparisons of temple systems past and present and sent Erudite Li Tianlin to Shangdu with them so the court could report back on what was feasible.

sentences.zh: 一曰都宮別殿，七廟、九廟之制。

translations.literal: First: the system of a central palace with separate halls—the institutions of seven temples and nine temples.
translations.idiomatic: First: the central-palace, separate-hall system—the institutions of the seven-temple and nine-temple arrangements.

sentences.zh: 《祭法》曰：「天子立七廟，三昭三穆與太祖之廟而七，諸侯、大夫、士降殺以兩。

translations.literal: The Record of Sacrifices says: "The Son of Heaven establishes seven temples: three zhao, three mu, and the temple of the Taizu, making seven; for feudal lords, grand masters, and servicemen the number is reduced by two at each rank."
translations.idiomatic: The Record of Sacrifices states: "The Son of Heaven establishes seven temples—three for zhao ancestors, three for mu ancestors, and the temple of the founding ancestor, making seven; feudal lords, grand masters, and servicemen reduce the number by two at each step down."

sentences.zh: 」晉博士孫毓以謂外為都宮，內各有寢廟，別有門垣。

translations.literal: " The Jin erudite Sun Yu held that outwardly there was a central palace, inwardly each had its own shrine and temple, and each had its own gate and wall.
translations.idiomatic: " The Jin ritualist Sun Yu explained that outwardly there was a central palace precinct, while within each ancestor had a separate shrine and sleeping hall, each with its own gate and enclosure.

sentences.zh: 太祖在北，左昭右穆，以次而南是也。

translations.literal: The Taizu was to the north; zhao on the left and mu on the right, proceeding southward in order—such was the arrangement.
translations.idiomatic: The founding ancestor stood to the north; zhao ancestors on the left and mu on the right, arrayed southward in order.

sentences.zh: 前廟後寢者，以象人君之居，前有朝而後有寢也。

translations.literal: Temple in front and sleeping hall behind symbolized the ruler's dwelling: court in front and private quarters behind.
translations.idiomatic: A front temple and rear sleeping hall mirrored a ruler's residence—audience hall in front and private quarters behind.

sentences.zh: 廟以藏主，以四時祭；

translations.literal: The temple stored the spirit tablets and received the four seasonal sacrifices;
translations.idiomatic: The temple housed the spirit tablets and received the four seasonal sacrifices;

sentences.zh: 寢有衣冠几杖象生之具，以薦新物。

translations.literal: the sleeping hall had robes, caps, tables, staffs, and lifelike furnishings, for presenting seasonal fresh offerings.
translations.idiomatic: the sleeping hall held robes, caps, tables, staffs, and lifelike furnishings for presenting seasonal fresh offerings.

sentences.zh: 天子太祖百世不遷，宗亦百世不遷，高祖以上，親盡則遞遷。

translations.literal: For the Son of Heaven, the Taizu was never moved for a hundred generations, and the zong likewise was never moved for a hundred generations; for ancestors above the great-grandfather, when the bond of kinship was exhausted they were moved in succession.
translations.idiomatic: For the Son of Heaven the founding ancestor and the lineage founder were never displaced for a hundred generations; ancestors above the great-grandfather, once kinship ties lapsed, were moved on in turn.

sentences.zh: 昭常為昭，穆常為穆，同為都宮，則昭常在左，穆常在右，而外有以不失其序。

translations.literal: Zhao remained zhao and mu remained mu; within the same central palace, zhao was always on the left and mu on the right, so that outwardly their order was not lost.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao lines stayed zhao and mu lines stayed mu; within one central precinct, zhao always stood to the left and mu to the right, preserving their proper order outwardly.

sentences.zh: 一世自為一廟，則昭不見穆，穆不見昭，而內有以各全其尊，必祫享而會於太祖之廟，然後序其尊卑之次。

translations.literal: Each generation had its own temple, so that zhao did not face mu and mu did not face zhao, yet inwardly each fully preserved its dignity; only when a collective offering assembled at the Taizu's temple could the order of senior and junior be arranged.
translations.idiomatic: Each generation had its own shrine, so zhao and mu never faced one another, yet each line kept its full dignity within; only at a collective offering in the founding ancestor's temple could seniority be properly ordered.

sentences.zh: 蓋父子異宮，祖禰異廟，所以盡事亡如事存之義。

translations.literal: Thus father and son had separate palaces, grandfather and great-grandfather separate temples—this was how the meaning of serving the dead as one serves the living was fully expressed.
translations.idiomatic: Father and son in separate halls, grandfather and great-grandfather in separate shrines—this was how one fulfilled the duty of honoring the dead as though they still lived.

sentences.zh: 然漢儒論七廟、九廟之數，其說有二。

translations.literal: Yet when Han scholars discussed the numbers of seven temples and nine temples, there were two schools of thought.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Han scholars disputed how to count seven or nine temples, and two rival theories emerged.

sentences.zh: 韋玄成等以謂周之所以七廟者，以後稷始封，文王、武王受命而王，是以三廟不毀，與親廟四而七也。

translations.literal: Wei Xuancheng and others held that the reason Zhou had seven temples was that Hou Ji was first enfeoffed, and King Wen and King Wu received the Mandate and became kings; therefore three temples were not destroyed, and together with four temples of close kinship this made seven.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Xuancheng and others argued that Zhou's seven temples arose because Hou Ji was first enfeoffed and Kings Wen and Wu received the Mandate—three shrines therefore never lapsed, which with four temples of close kin made seven.

sentences.zh: 如劉歆之說，則周自武王克商，以後稷為太祖，即增立高圉、亞圉二廟於公叔、太王、王季、文王二昭二穆之上，已為七廟矣。

translations.literal: According to Liu Xin's theory, from the time King Wu of Zhou conquered Shang and took Hou Ji as Taizu, he at once added temples for Gao Yu and Ya Yu above the two zhao and two mu of Gongshu, Grand King, King Ji, and King Wen—already making seven temples.
translations.idiomatic: In Liu Xin's account, once King Wu conquered Shang and made Hou Ji the founding ancestor, he immediately added shrines for Gao Yu and Ya Yu above the two zhao and two mu of Gongshu, Grand King, King Ji, and King Wen—already seven temples.

sentences.zh: 至懿王時始立文世室於三穆之上，至孝王時始立武世室於三昭之上，是為九廟矣。

translations.literal: Only in the time of King Yi was Wen's perpetual shrine established above the three mu; only in the time of King Xiao was Wu's perpetual shrine established above the three zhao—thus making nine temples.
translations.idiomatic: Only under King Yi was a perpetual shrine to King Wen set above the three mu lines; only under King Xiao was one to King Wu set above the three zhao—making nine temples in all.

sentences.zh: 然先儒多是劉歆之說。

translations.literal: Yet most earlier scholars followed Liu Xin's theory.
translations.idiomatic: Most earlier scholars, however, followed Liu Xin's account.

sentences.zh: 二曰同堂異室之制。

translations.literal: Second: the system of one hall with separate chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Second: the single-hall, separate-chamber system.

sentences.zh: 後漢明帝遵儉自抑，遺詔無起寢廟，但藏其主於光武廟中更衣別室。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming of Later Han practiced frugality and self-restraint; his testamentary edict ordered that no sleeping halls or temples be built, but only that his spirit tablet be stored in a separate chamber for changing robes within Emperor Guangwu's temple.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming of Later Han practiced austerity; his deathbed edict forbade new sleeping halls or shrines and directed only that his tablet be kept in a robing side chamber within Emperor Guangwu's temple.

sentences.zh: 其後章帝又復如之，後世遂不敢加。

translations.literal: Thereafter Emperor Zhang did the same again, and later ages did not dare to add to this.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhang followed suit, and later dynasties did not dare depart from the precedent.

sentences.zh: 而公私之廟，皆用同堂異室之制。

translations.literal: Both public and private ancestral temples all adopted the system of one hall with separate chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Both imperial and private ancestral shrines alike adopted the single-hall, separate-chamber layout.

sentences.zh: 先儒朱熹以謂至使太祖之位，下同孫子，而更僻處於一隅，無以見為七廟之尊；

translations.literal: The earlier scholar Zhu Xi held that this went so far as to place the Taizu's seat on the same level as grandsons, while relegating him to a remote corner, so that the dignity of seven temples could not be seen;
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Xi objected that this reduced the founding ancestor to a grandson's rank while banishing him to a corner, effacing the grandeur proper to seven temples;

sentences.zh: 群廟之神，則又上厭祖考，不得自為一廟之主。

translations.literal: and the spirits of the collective temples, being pressed down by ancestors above, could not each be master of a separate temple.
translations.idiomatic: while the spirits of the other shrines, overshadowed by ancestors above them, could not each preside over a temple of their own.

sentences.zh: 以人情論之，生居九重，窮極壯麗，而設祭一室，不過尋丈，甚或無地以容鼎俎，而陰損其數，子孫之心，於此宜亦有所不安矣。

translations.literal: Speaking in terms of human feeling, in life one dwelt within the ninefold palace in utmost splendor, yet for sacrifice a single chamber measured only a few feet, and sometimes there was not even room for tripods and stands; secretly reducing the number of offerings, the hearts of descendants at this must surely have felt some unease.
translations.idiomatic: By ordinary human standards, a ruler who lived amid the splendor of the ninefold palace was offered sacrifice in a chamber only a few feet across—sometimes with no room even for tripods and stands—and the number of offerings was quietly cut back; descendants' hearts must surely have felt uneasy at that.

sentences.zh: 且如命士以上，其父子婦姑，猶且異處，謹尊卑之序，不相褻瀆。

translations.literal: Moreover, even for servicemen of the appointed rank and above, father and son, wife and mother-in-law still had separate quarters, carefully observing the order of senior and junior without mutual profanation.
translations.idiomatic: Even servicemen of appointed rank and above kept father and son, wife and mother-in-law in separate quarters, strictly observing seniority without mutual disrespect.

sentences.zh: 況天子貴為一人，富有四海，而祖宗神位數世同處一堂，有失人子事亡如事存之意矣。

translations.literal: How much more so for the Son of Heaven, honored as the one man who possesses the four seas—yet the spirit seats of ancestors for many generations shared one hall, which lost the meaning of a son's serving the dead as he serves the living.
translations.idiomatic: How much less fitting was it for the Son of Heaven, lord of the four seas, to house the spirit seats of many generations of ancestors in a single hall—betraying the filial duty of honoring the dead as though they still lived.

sentences.zh: 十六年八月丁酉，以江南所獲玉爵及坫，凡四十九事，納於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou in the eighth month of the sixteenth year, forty-nine jade goblets and stands captured in Jiangnan were deposited in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the eighth month of year 16, forty-nine jade goblets and stands captured in Jiangnan were deposited in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 十七年十二月甲申，告遷於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen in the twelfth month of the seventeenth year, announcement was made of the move to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the twelfth month of year 17, notice was given of the move to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，承旨和禮霍孫，太常卿太出、禿忽思等，以祏室內栗主八位並日月山版位、聖安寺木主俱遷。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, the palace steward Heli Huosun, the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Taichu, Tuhusi, and others moved the eight wooden spirit tablets from within the collateral shrine together with the plaque tablets for the Sun, Moon, and Mountains and the wooden tablets from Sheng'an Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Palace Steward Heli Huosun, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Taichu, Tuhusi, and others moved the eight wooden tablets from the collateral shrine, together with the Sun-Moon-Mountain plaques and the wooden tablets from Sheng'an Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲午，和禮霍孫、太常卿撒裏蠻率百官奉太祖、睿宗二室金主於新廟安奉，遂大享焉。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Heli Huosun and the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Saliman led the hundred officials in reverently installing the gold spirit tablets of the two chambers of Taizu and Ruizong in the new temple, and thereupon a great offering was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Heli Huosun and Director Saliman led the officials in installing the gilded spirit tablets of Taizu and Ruizong in the new temple, after which a great offering was held.

sentences.zh: 乙未，毀舊廟。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the old temple was demolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day the old temple was demolished.

sentences.zh: 十八年二月，博士李時衍等議：「歷代廟制，俱各不同。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighteenth year, the erudites Li Shiyan and others deliberated: "The temple systems of successive dynasties were all different.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 18 the erudites Li Shiyan and others ruled: "Temple systems differed in every dynasty.

sentences.zh: 欲尊祖宗，當從都宮別殿之制；

translations.literal: If one wishes to honor ancestors and forebears, one should follow the system of a central palace with separate halls;
translations.idiomatic: To honor one's ancestors properly, one should follow the central-palace, separate-hall system;

sentences.zh: 欲崇儉約，當從同堂異室之制。

translations.literal: if one wishes to esteem frugality and restraint, one should follow the system of one hall with separate chambers."
translations.idiomatic: to esteem frugality, one should follow the single-hall, separate-chamber system."

sentences.zh: 」三月十一日，尚書段那海及太常禮官奏曰：「始議七廟，除正殿、寢殿、正門、東西門已建外，東西六廟不須更造，余依太常寺新圖建之。

translations.literal: " On the eleventh day of the third month, the Minister Duan Naihai and the ritual officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices memorialized: "In the initial plan for seven temples, apart from the main hall, sleeping hall, main gate, and eastern and western gates already built, the six eastern and western temples need not be newly constructed; the remainder should be built according to the new diagram of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices."
translations.idiomatic: " On the eleventh day of the third month Minister Duan Naihai and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "Under the original seven-temple plan, since the main hall, sleeping hall, main gate, and east and west gates are already built, the six flanking temples need not be rebuilt; the rest should follow the Court's new design."

sentences.zh: 」遂為前廟、後寢，廟分七室。

translations.literal: " Thereupon it was arranged as temple in front and sleeping hall behind, the temple divided into seven chambers.
translations.idiomatic: " The layout was fixed as temple in front and sleeping hall behind, with seven ritual chambers.

sentences.zh: 二十一年三月丁卯，太廟正殿成，奉安神主。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao in the third month of the twenty-first year, the main hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed, and the spirit tablets were installed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the third month of year 21 the Imperial Ancestral Temple's main hall was completed and the spirit tablets installed.

sentences.zh: 九月，廟室掛鐵綱釘鏨籠門告成。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the hanging of iron chains, nails, chiseled cage doors for the temple chambers was announced complete.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month installation of the iron chains, nails, and chiseled cage doors for the temple chambers was declared complete.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，成宗即位，追尊皇考為皇帝，廟號裕宗。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, when Chengzong ascended the throne, he posthumously honored his imperial father as emperor with the temple name Yuzong.
translations.idiomatic: In year 31, when Chengzong took the throne, he posthumously honored his father as emperor with the temple name Yuzong.

sentences.zh: 元貞元年冬十月癸卯，有事於太廟。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter in the first year of Yuanzhen, on the day guimao, there was a ceremony at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the tenth winter month of Yuanzhen 1, a temple ceremony was held.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「去歲世祖、皇后、裕宗祔廟，以綾代玉冊。

translations.literal: A member of the Secretariat said: "Last year, when Shizu, the empress, and Yuzong were enshrined in the temple, silk was used in place of jade registers.
translations.idiomatic: A Secretariat official reported: "When Shizu, the empress, and Yuzong were enshrined last year, silk registers were used in place of jade ones.

sentences.zh: 今玉冊、玉寶成，請納諸各室。

translations.literal: Now the jade registers and jade seals are completed; we request that they be deposited in the respective chambers."
translations.idiomatic: The jade registers and seals are now finished; we ask that they be placed in the respective chambers."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「親饗之禮，祖宗未嘗行之。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "The rite of personal offering—our ancestors and forebears never practiced it.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "The rite of personal offering—our ancestors never performed it.

sentences.zh: 其奉冊以來，朕躬祝之。

translations.literal: When the registers are brought in, I myself shall offer the prayer."
translations.idiomatic: When the registers are brought in, I shall offer the prayer myself."

sentences.zh: 」命獻官迎導入廟。

translations.literal: " He ordered the presenting officers to welcome and escort them into the temple.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered the presenting officers to receive and escort them into the temple.

sentences.zh: 大德元年十一月，太保月赤察兒等奏請廟享增用馬，制可。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Dade, the Grand Preceptor Yuechichae'r and others memorialized requesting that horses be added to the temple offering; the emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Dade 1, Grand Preceptor Yuechichae'r and others asked that horses be added to the temple offering; the emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，特祭太廟，用馬一，牛一，羊鹿野豕天鵝各七，余品如舊，為特祭之始。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, a special sacrifice was held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, using one horse, one ox, and seven each of sheep, deer, wild boar, and swans; other items were as before—this was the beginning of special sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 2 a special temple sacrifice was held using one horse, one ox, and seven each of sheep, deer, wild boar, and swans, with other offerings as before—marking the beginning of special sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 四年八月，以皇妣、皇后祔。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year, the imperial mother and empress were enshrined.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 4 the imperial mother and empress were enshrined.

sentences.zh: 六年五月戊申，太廟寢殿災。

translations.literal: On the day wushen in the fifth month of the sixth year, the sleeping hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was destroyed by fire.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the fifth month of year 6 the Imperial Ancestral Temple's sleeping hall burned down.

sentences.zh: 十一年，武宗即位，追尊皇考為皇帝，廟號順宗。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, when Wuzong ascended the throne, he posthumously honored his imperial father as emperor with the temple name Shunzong.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11, when Wuzong took the throne, he posthumously honored his father as emperor with the temple name Shunzong.

sentences.zh: 太祖室居中，睿宗西第一室，世祖西第二室，裕宗西第三室，順宗東第一室，成宗東第二室。

translations.literal: Taizu's chamber was in the center; Ruizong in the first western chamber, Shizu in the second western chamber, Yuzong in the third western chamber, Shunzong in the first eastern chamber, and Chengzong in the second eastern chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu's chamber stood at the center; Ruizong occupied the first western chamber, Shizu the second western, Yuzong the third western, Shunzong the first eastern, and Chengzong the second eastern.

sentences.zh: 追尊先元妃為皇后，祔成宗室。

translations.literal: The former primary consort was posthumously honored as empress and enshrined in Chengzong's chamber.
translations.idiomatic: His former primary consort was posthumously named empress and enshrined in Chengzong's chamber.

sentences.zh: 至大二年春正月乙未，以受尊號，恭謝太廟，為親祀之始。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei in the first month of spring in the second year of Zhida, because he had received an honorific title, he reverently offered thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple—this was the beginning of personal sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the first spring month of Zhida 2, having received an honorific title, he reverently offered thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple—marking the beginning of the emperor's personal temple worship.

sentences.zh: 十月，以將加謚太祖、睿宗，擇日請太祖、睿宗尊謚於天，擇日請光獻皇后、莊聖皇后尊謚於廟，改制金表神主，題寫尊謚廟號。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, because posthumous titles were to be added for Taizu and Ruizong, days were chosen to request Taizu and Ruizong's posthumous titles from Heaven, and days were chosen to request posthumous titles for Empresses Guangxian and Zhuangsheng at the temple; new gilded spirit tablets were made, inscribed with posthumous titles and temple names.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, as posthumous titles were to be conferred on Taizu and Ruizong, days were set to seek their titles from Heaven and those of Empresses Guangxian and Zhuangsheng at the temple; new gilded spirit tablets were cast bearing their posthumous titles and temple names.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，親享太廟，奉玉冊、玉寶。

translations.literal: On the day yimao in the twelfth month, he personally offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and presented jade registers and jade seals.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the twelfth month he personally offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and presented the jade registers and seals.

sentences.zh: 加上太祖聖武皇帝尊謚曰法天啟運，廟號太祖，光獻皇后曰翼聖。

translations.literal: To Taizu, the Sagely Martial Emperor, was added the posthumous title "Aligning with Heaven and Initiating Fortune," with temple name Taizu; to Empress Guangxian was added "Assisting the Sage."
translations.idiomatic: Taizu, the Sagely Martial Emperor, received the added posthumous title "Aligning with Heaven and Initiating Fortune," retaining the temple name Taizu; Empress Guangxian received "Assisting the Sage."

sentences.zh: 加上睿宗景襄皇帝曰仁聖，廟號睿宗，莊聖皇后曰顯懿。

translations.literal: To Emperor Ruizong Jingxiang was added "Benevolent and Sagely," with temple name Ruizong; to Empress Zhuangsheng was added "Manifest and Virtuous."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ruizong Jingxiang received "Benevolent and Sagely," with temple name Ruizong; Empress Zhuangsheng received "Manifest and Virtuous."

sentences.zh: 其舊制，金表神主，以櫝貯兩旁，自是主皆範金作之，如金表之制。

translations.literal: Under the old system, gilded spirit tablets were stored in cases on either side; from this time onward all spirit tablets were cast in gold, following the gilded tablet system.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old practice gilded tablets had been kept in cases on either side; henceforth all spirit tablets were cast in gold to the same standard.

sentences.zh: 延祐七年，仁宗升祔，增置廟室。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yanyou, when Renzong was enshrined, additional temple chambers were established.
translations.idiomatic: In Yanyou 7, when Renzong was enshrined, additional temple chambers were added.

sentences.zh: 太常禮儀院下博士檢討歷代典故，移書禮部、中書集議曰：「古者天子祭七代，兄弟同為一代，廟室皆有神主，增置廟室。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Ritual ordered the erudites to review precedents of successive dynasties and sent a dispatch to the Ministry of Rites and the Secretariat for joint deliberation, stating: "In antiquity the Son of Heaven sacrificed to seven generations; brothers counted as one generation, and every temple chamber had spirit tablets—additional temple chambers were established."
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices ordered its erudites to review dynastic precedents and wrote to the Ministry of Rites and Secretariat for joint deliberation: "In antiquity the Son of Heaven sacrificed to seven generations; brothers counted as one generation, and every chamber had its spirit tablet—additional chambers were added as needed."

sentences.zh: 」又議：「大行皇帝升祔太廟，七室皆有神主，增室不及。

translations.literal: " They further deliberated: "When the late emperor is enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, all seven chambers already have spirit tablets, and there is not room to add chambers.
translations.idiomatic: " They added: "When the late emperor is enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, all seven chambers already hold spirit tablets, and there is no room to add more chambers.

sentences.zh: 依前代典故，權於廟內止設幄座，面南安奉。

translations.literal: Following precedents of earlier dynasties, provisionally only a canopy seat should be set up within the temple, facing south for installation."
translations.idiomatic: Following earlier precedents, a canopy seat should temporarily be set up within the temple, facing south for the installation."

sentences.zh: 今相視得第七室近南對室地位，東西一丈五尺，除設幄座外，余五尺，不妨行禮。

translations.literal: Upon inspection, a place was found south of the seventh chamber opposite its door, one zhang and five chi east to west; apart from the canopy seat, five chi remained, which would not obstruct the rites.
translations.idiomatic: On inspection a space was found south of the seventh chamber's opposite doorway, one zhang and five chi across; apart from the canopy seat, five chi remained—enough not to obstruct the rites.

sentences.zh: 」乃結彩為殿，置武宗室南，權奉神主。

translations.literal: " Thereupon a hall of colored silk was erected, Wuzong's chamber was placed to the south, and the spirit tablet was provisionally installed.
translations.idiomatic: " A hall of colored silk was erected to the south of Wuzong's chamber, and his spirit tablet was provisionally installed there.

sentences.zh: 十月戊子，英宗將以四時躬祀太廟，命太常禮官與中書、翰林、集賢等官集議其禮制，曰：「此追遠報本之道也，毋以朕勞而有所損焉，其一遵典禮。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi in the tenth month, because Yingzong was about to personally sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple in all four seasons, he ordered the ritual officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices together with the Secretariat, Hanlin Academy, Academy of Scholarly Worthies, and other officials to assemble and deliberate on the ritual regulations, saying: "This is the way of honoring the distant and repaying one's roots; do not diminish the rites because of my fatigue—follow the canonical ceremonies throughout."
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the tenth month, as Yingzong was about to sacrifice personally at the Imperial Ancestral Temple in all four seasons, he ordered ritual officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, the Secretariat, Hanlin Academy, Academy of Scholarly Worthies, and others to deliberate on the regulations, saying: "This is how one honors the distant and repays one's roots; do not curtail the rites because of my fatigue—follow the canonical ceremonies in full."

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，中書以躬謝太廟儀註進。

translations.literal: " On the day bingyin, the Secretariat submitted the ritual protocol for personal thanksgiving at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: " On the bingyin day the Secretariat submitted the protocol for the emperor's personal thanksgiving at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子朔，帝御齋宮。

translations.literal: On the first day bingzi of the eleventh month, the emperor resided in the fasting palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the first bingzi day of the eleventh month the emperor entered the fasting palace.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，備法駕儀衛，躬謝太廟，至欞星門駕止，有司進輦不禦，步至大次，服袞冕端拱以俟。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, with the imperial carriage and guard arrayed, he personally offered thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; arriving at the Lattice Star Gate the carriage halted, the officials presented the palanquin but he did not mount, walking instead to the great tent, donning the dragon robe and cap and sitting upright with hands joined to await.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, with the imperial carriage and guard arrayed, he went in person to offer thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple. At the Lattice Star Gate the carriage halted; though officials offered the palanquin he would not mount it, but walked to the great tent, donned the dragon robe and cap, and sat upright with hands joined to await the rites.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使請署祝，帝降御座正立書名。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies requested that the prayer be signed; the emperor descended from the imperial seat, stood upright, and wrote his name.
translations.idiomatic: The Master of Ceremonies asked that the prayer text be signed; the emperor stepped down from the throne, stood upright, and wrote his name.

sentences.zh: 及讀祝，敕高贊御名。

translations.literal: When the prayer was read, he ordered that his imperial name be proclaimed aloud.
translations.idiomatic: When the prayer was read aloud, he ordered his imperial name proclaimed in a high voice.

sentences.zh: 至仁宗室，輒歔欷流涕，左右莫不感動。

translations.literal: When he reached Renzong's chamber, he would sigh and weep, and none beside him were unmoved.
translations.idiomatic: At Renzong's chamber he would sigh and weep, and all those beside him were moved.

sentences.zh: 退至西神門，殿中監受圭，出降沒階乃授。

translations.literal: He withdrew to the Western Spirit Gate; the Director of the Palace received the jade tablet, and only after descending the hidden steps was it handed over.
translations.idiomatic: He withdrew to the Western Spirit Gate; the Director of the Palace received the jade tablet and handed it over only after the emperor had descended the hidden steps.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，太常進時享太廟儀式。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices submitted the ritual protocol for seasonal offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day the Court of Imperial Sacrifices submitted the protocol for seasonal offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 至治元年正月乙酉，始命於太廟垣西北建大次殿。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou in the first month of the first year of Zhizhi, orders were first issued to build the great tent hall northwest of the Imperial Ancestral Temple enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the first month of Zhizhi 1, orders were first issued to build the great tent hall northwest of the Imperial Ancestral Temple precinct.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，始以四孟月時享，親祀太室。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, seasonal offerings in the four first months of the seasons were begun, and he personally sacrificed at the Great Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day seasonal offerings in the four first months of the seasons began, and he personally sacrificed at the Great Chamber.

sentences.zh: 禮成，坐大次謂群臣曰：「朕纘承祖宗丕緒，夙夜祗栗，無以報稱，歲惟四祀，使人代之，不能至如在之誠，實所未安。

translations.literal: When the rites were completed, seated in the great tent he said to the assembled ministers: "I have inherited the great enterprise of my ancestors and forebears, and day and night I am reverently fearful, yet have no means to repay them. Each year there are only four sacrifices, and I send others in my place—I cannot attain the sincerity of being present in person, and this truly leaves me uneasy.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were finished, seated in the great tent he told the ministers: "I have inherited my ancestors' great enterprise and am reverently fearful day and night, yet cannot repay them as I ought. Only four sacrifices come each year, and I send others in my place—I cannot match the sincerity of being there myself, and this truly troubles me.

sentences.zh: 自今以始，歲必親祀，以終朕身。

translations.literal: From this time forward, each year I shall sacrifice in person, for the rest of my life."
translations.idiomatic: From now on I shall sacrifice in person every year for the rest of my life."

sentences.zh: 」五月，中書省臣言：「以廟制事，集御史臺、翰林院、太常院臣議。

translations.literal: " In the fifth month, a member of the Secretariat said: "Regarding the temple system, we have assembled ministers of the Censorate, Hanlin Academy, and Court of Imperial Sacrifices for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fifth month a Secretariat official reported: "On the temple system we have assembled ministers from the Censorate, Hanlin Academy, and Court of Imperial Sacrifices for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 謹按前代廟室，多寡不同。

translations.literal: We respectfully note that the temple chambers of earlier dynasties differed in number.
translations.idiomatic: We note that earlier dynasties' temple chambers differed in number.

sentences.zh: 晉則兄弟同為一室，正室增為十四間，東西各一間。

translations.literal: In Jin, brothers shared one chamber; the main hall was increased to fourteen bays, with one bay each to east and west.
translations.idiomatic: In Jin, brothers shared one chamber; the main hall was expanded to fourteen bays, with one bay each to east and west.

sentences.zh: 唐九廟，後增為十一室。

translations.literal: Tang had nine temples, later increased to eleven chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Tang began with nine temples, later expanded to eleven chambers.

sentences.zh: 宋增室至十八，東西夾室各一間，以藏祧主。

translations.literal: Song increased chambers to eighteen, with one flanking chamber each to east and west for storing distant ancestral tablets.
translations.idiomatic: Song expanded to eighteen chambers, with one flanking chamber on each side to store distant ancestral tablets.

sentences.zh: 今太廟雖分八室，然兄弟為世，止六世而已。

translations.literal: Today the Imperial Ancestral Temple is divided into eight chambers, yet brothers count as one generation, amounting to only six generations.
translations.idiomatic: Today's Imperial Ancestral Temple has eight chambers, but with brothers counting as one generation there are only six generations in all.

sentences.zh: 世祖所建前廟後寢，往歲寢殿災。

translations.literal: The temple in front and sleeping hall behind that Shizu built—last year the sleeping hall was destroyed by fire.
translations.idiomatic: The front temple and rear sleeping hall that Shizu built saw the sleeping hall burn down last year.

sentences.zh: 請以今殿為寢，別作前廟十五間，中三間通為一室，以奉太祖神主，余以次為室，庶幾情文得宜。

translations.literal: We request that the present hall serve as the sleeping hall, and that a separate front temple of fifteen bays be built, the central three bays joined as one chamber to receive Taizu's spirit tablet, the remainder arranged as chambers in order, so that feeling and form may both be fitting.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the present hall serve as the sleeping hall while a new front temple of fifteen bays is built, the central three bays joined as one chamber for Taizu's spirit tablet and the rest arranged as chambers in order, so that ritual form and sentiment may both be fitting.

sentences.zh: 謹上太常廟制。

translations.literal: We respectfully submit the temple system of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices."
translations.idiomatic: We respectfully submit the Court of Imperial Sacrifices' proposed temple layout."

sentences.zh: 」制曰：「善，期以來歲營之。」

translations.literal: " The emperor decreed: "Good; schedule construction for next year."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor decreed: "Well said; begin construction next year."

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁丑，始陳鹵簿，親享太廟。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou in the first month of spring in the second year, the imperial guard array was first displayed, and he personally offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the first spring month of year 2 the imperial guard array was first displayed, and he personally offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 三月二十三日，以新作太廟正殿，夏秋二祭權止。

translations.literal: On the twenty-third day of the third month, because the main hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was newly built, the summer and autumn sacrifices were provisionally suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-third day of the third month, because the Imperial Ancestral Temple's main hall was newly built, the summer and autumn sacrifices were temporarily suspended.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丙辰，太皇太后崩，太常院官奏：「國哀以日易月，旬有二日外，乃舉祀事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on the day bingchen, the Grand Empress Dowager passed away; officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices memorialized: "In national mourning, days are counted as months; only after twelve days and more may sacrificial affairs be conducted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth autumn month, on the bingchen day, the Grand Empress Dowager died; Court of Imperial Sacrifices officials reported: "In national mourning days are reckoned as months; only after twelve days may sacrifices resume.

sentences.zh: 有司以十月戊辰，有事於太廟，取聖裁。

translations.literal: The responsible officials propose the day wuchen in the tenth month for a ceremony at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; we seek the sage decision."
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials propose holding a temple ceremony on the wuchen day of the tenth month and seek Your Majesty's decision."

sentences.zh: 」制曰：「太廟禮不可廢，迎香去樂可也。

translations.literal: " The emperor decreed: "The rites of the Imperial Ancestral Temple cannot be abandoned; welcoming incense while omitting music will suffice."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor decreed: "The Imperial Ancestral Temple rites cannot be abandoned; incense may be offered without music."

sentences.zh: 」又言：「太廟興工未畢，有妨陳宮縣樂，請止用登歌。

translations.literal: " They further said: "Construction at the Imperial Ancestral Temple is not yet complete, which hinders the display of palace and county music; we request that only the ascending hymns be used."
translations.idiomatic: " They added: "Construction at the Imperial Ancestral Temple is not yet finished, which prevents the full palace orchestra; we ask to use only the ascending hymns."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 三年春三月戊申，祔昭獻元聖皇后於順宗室。

translations.literal: On the day wushen in the third month of spring in the third year, Empress Zhaoxian Yuansheng was enshrined in Shunzong's chamber.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the third spring month of year 3, Empress Zhaoxian Yuansheng was enshrined in Shunzong's chamber.

sentences.zh: 夏四月六日，上都分省參議速速，以都堂旨，太廟夾室未有制度，再約臺院等官議定。

translations.literal: On the sixth day of the fourth month of summer, Sushu, participating secretary of the Shangdu branch secretariat, by order of the chief secretariat, noted that the Imperial Ancestral Temple's flanking chambers had no established system, and again convened officials of the censorate and academies to fix it.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth day of the fourth summer month, Sushu of the Shangdu branch secretariat reported by chief secretariat order that the Imperial Ancestral Temple's flanking chambers lacked a fixed system, and convened censorate and academy officials to settle it.

sentences.zh: 博士議曰：「按《爾雅》曰『室有東西廂曰廟』，《註》：『夾室前堂。

translations.literal: The erudites deliberated: "According to the Erya, 'A dwelling with eastern and western wings is called a temple'; the commentary says, 'The flanking chamber's front hall.'
translations.idiomatic: The erudites ruled: "The Erya states, 'A dwelling with eastern and western wings is called a temple'; the commentary reads, 'The flanking chamber's front hall.'

sentences.zh: 』同禮曰『西夾南向』，《註》曰『西廂夾室』。

translations.literal: ' The same Rites says 'the western flank faces south'; the commentary says 'the western wing's flanking chamber.'
translations.idiomatic: ' The Rites likewise says 'the western flank faces south'; the commentary reads 'the western wing's flanking chamber.'

sentences.zh: 此東西夾室之正文也。

translations.literal: This is the authoritative text on eastern and western flanking chambers.
translations.idiomatic: This is the authoritative text on eastern and western flanking chambers.

sentences.zh: 賈公彥曰：『室有東西廂曰廟，其夾皆在序。

translations.literal: Jia Gongyan said: 'A dwelling with eastern and western wings is called a temple; its flanks are all in the side halls.'
translations.idiomatic: Jia Gongyan said: 'A dwelling with eastern and western wings is called a temple; its flanks are all in the side halls.'

sentences.zh: 』是則夾者，猶今耳房之類也。

translations.literal: ' Thus the flank is like today's side rooms.
translations.idiomatic: ' Thus a flank chamber is like today's side rooms.

sentences.zh: 然其制度，則未之聞。

translations.literal: Yet its specific system has not been heard of.
translations.idiomatic: Yet its specific layout has not been clearly recorded.

sentences.zh: 東晉太廟正室一十六間，東西儲各一間，共十有八。

translations.literal: The Eastern Jin Imperial Ancestral Temple's main hall had sixteen bays, with one storage bay each to east and west, eighteen in all.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Jin Imperial Ancestral Temple's main hall had sixteen bays, with one storage bay on each side—eighteen in all.

sentences.zh: 所謂儲者，非夾室與？

translations.literal: What were called storage bays—were they not flanking chambers?
translations.idiomatic: Were these so-called storage bays not flanking chambers?

sentences.zh: 唐貞觀故事，遷廟之主，藏於夾室西壁，南北三間。

translations.literal: Under Tang's Zhenguan precedent, spirit tablets moved from the main temple were stored on the west wall of the flanking chamber, three bays north to south.
translations.idiomatic: Under Tang's Zhenguan precedent, tablets displaced from the main temple were stored on the west wall of the flanking chamber, three bays from north to south.

sentences.zh: 又宋哲宗亦嘗於東夾室奉安，後雖增建一室，其夾室仍舊。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhezong of Song also once installed tablets in the eastern flanking chamber; though a chamber was later added, the flanking chambers remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhezong of Song also once installed tablets in the eastern flanking chamber; though an additional chamber was later built, the flanking chambers remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 是唐、宋夾室，與諸室制度無大異也。

translations.literal: Thus the flanking chambers of Tang and Song differed little in system from the other chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Tang and Song flanking chambers differed little in design from the main chambers.

sentences.zh: 五帝不相沿樂，三王不相襲禮。

translations.literal: The Five Emperors did not inherit one another's music; the Three Kings did not adopt one another's rites.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Emperors did not inherit one another's music; the Three Kings did not adopt one another's rites.

sentences.zh: 今廟制皆不合古，權宜一時。

translations.literal: Today's temple system conforms to antiquity in none of its parts and is an expedient for the moment.
translations.idiomatic: Today's temple system conforms to antiquity in none of its parts and is an expedient for the present.

sentences.zh: 宜取今廟一十五間，南北六間，東西兩頭二間，準唐南北三間之制，壘至棟為三間，壁以紅泥，以準東西序，南向為門，如今室戶之制，虛前以準廂，所謂夾室前堂也。

translations.literal: It is fitting to take the present temple's fifteen bays: six bays north to south, two bays at each eastern and western end; following Tang's three-bay north-south system, stacking to the ridge beam as three bays, walls of red clay, matching the eastern and western side halls, with doors facing south as in the present chamber-door system, leaving the front open to match the wing—what is called the flanking chamber's front hall.
translations.idiomatic: We propose using the present temple's fifteen bays—six from north to south and two at each end—following Tang's three-bay north-south module, stacked to the ridge as three bays with red-clay walls matching the side halls, doors facing south as in present chamber doors, and the front left open as a wing—the so-called flanking chamber's front hall.

sentences.zh: 雖未盡合於古，於今事為宜。

translations.literal: Though it does not fully accord with antiquity, for present affairs it is fitting."
translations.idiomatic: Though it does not fully match antiquity, it is fitting for present needs."

sentences.zh: 」六月，上都中書省以聞，制若曰「可」。

translations.literal: " In the sixth month, the Shangdu Secretariat reported this, and the emperor decreed as if saying "Approved."
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixth month the Shangdu Secretariat reported this, and the emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 壬申，敕以太廟前殿十有五間，東西二間為夾室，南向。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, an edict ordered that the Imperial Ancestral Temple's front hall have fifteen bays, with two bays east and west as flanking chambers, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day an edict ordered the Imperial Ancestral Temple's front hall to have fifteen bays, with two eastern and western bays as flanking chambers facing south.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，太廟落成。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day xinmao, the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on the xinmao day, the Imperial Ancestral Temple was completed.

sentences.zh: 俄，國有大故，晉王即皇帝位。

translations.literal: Shortly after, the state suffered a great bereavement, and the Prince of Jin ascended the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly after, the state suffered a great bereavement, and the Prince of Jin ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，追尊皇考晉王為皇帝，廟號顯宗，皇妣晉王妃為皇后。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen in the twelfth month, the imperial father, the Prince of Jin, was posthumously honored as emperor with the temple name Xianzong, and the imperial mother, consort of the Prince of Jin, as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the twelfth month the emperor's father, the Prince of Jin, was posthumously named emperor with the temple name Xianzong, and his mother, the prince's consort, was named empress.

sentences.zh: 庚午，盜入太廟，失仁宗及慈聖皇后神主。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, thieves entered the Imperial Ancestral Temple and the spirit tablets of Renzong and Empress Cisheng were lost.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day thieves broke into the Imperial Ancestral Temple and stole the spirit tablets of Renzong and Empress Cisheng.

sentences.zh: 壬申，重作仁廟二金主。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, two new gold spirit tablets for Renzong's temple were made.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day two new gilded spirit tablets for Renzong's shrine were cast.

sentences.zh: 丙午，御史趙成慶言：「太廟失神主，乃古今莫大之變。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Censor Zhao Chengqing said: "The loss of spirit tablets from the Imperial Ancestral Temple is the greatest change from ancient times to the present.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Censor Zhao Chengqing said: "The loss of spirit tablets from the Imperial Ancestral Temple is the gravest breach in all history.

sentences.zh: 由太常禮官不恭厥職，宜正其罪，以謝宗廟，以安神靈。

translations.literal: It arose because the ritual officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices were not reverent in their duties; their crimes should be punished to appease the ancestral temple and settle the spirits."
translations.idiomatic: It arose because the Court of Imperial Sacrifices officials failed in their duties; they should be punished to appease the ancestral temple and settle the spirits."

sentences.zh: 」制命中書定罪。

translations.literal: " An imperial decree ordered the Secretariat to fix their punishments.
translations.idiomatic: " An imperial decree ordered the Secretariat to determine their punishments.

sentences.zh: 先是，博士劉致建議曰：

translations.literal: Earlier, the erudite Liu Zhi had submitted a proposal, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Erudite Liu Zhi had submitted a proposal:

sentences.zh: 竊以禮莫大於宗廟。

translations.literal: I venture to hold that in ritual nothing is greater than the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that in ritual nothing is greater than the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 宗廟者，天下國家之本，禮樂刑政之所自出也。

translations.literal: The ancestral temple is the foundation of all under Heaven and the state, the source from which ritual, music, punishments, and government proceed.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestral temple is the foundation of empire and state, the source from which ritual, music, punishments, and government proceed.

sentences.zh: 唐、虞、三代而下，靡不由之。

translations.literal: From Tang and Yu through the Three Dynasties and thereafter, none have failed to follow this.
translations.idiomatic: From Tang and Yu through the Three Dynasties and beyond, none have failed to follow this.

sentences.zh: 聖元龍興朔陲，積德累功，百有餘年，而宗廟未有一定之制。

translations.literal: Holy Yuan arose like a dragon in the northern frontier, accumulating virtue and merit for more than a hundred years, yet the ancestral temple has had no fixed system.
translations.idiomatic: Holy Yuan arose in the northern frontier, accumulating virtue and merit for more than a century, yet the ancestral temple still lacks a fixed system.

sentences.zh: 方聖天子繼統之初，定一代不刊之典，為萬世法程，正在今日。

translations.literal: Now at the beginning of the sage Son of Heaven's succession, to fix an immutable canon for the age and set a model for ten thousand generations—this is precisely the task of today.
translations.idiomatic: Now, at the beginning of the sage emperor's reign, to fix an immutable canon for the age and set a model for ten thousand generations is precisely today's task.

sentences.zh: 周制，天子七廟，三昭三穆，昭處於東，穆處於西，所以別父子親疏之序，而使不亂也。

translations.literal: Under the Zhou system, the Son of Heaven had seven temples, three zhao and three mu; zhao were placed in the east and mu in the west, thereby distinguishing the order of father and son, close and distant kin, and keeping it from confusion.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Zhou system the Son of Heaven had seven temples—three zhao and three mu—with zhao in the east and mu in the west, distinguishing father from son and close from distant kin so that order was preserved.

sentences.zh: 聖朝取唐、宋之制，定為九世，遂以舊廟八室而為六世，昭穆不分，父子並坐，不合《禮經》。

translations.literal: Our holy dynasty took the Tang and Song systems and fixed nine generations; thus the old temple's eight chambers became six generations, with zhao and mu undistinguished and father and son seated together—this does not accord with the Ritual Canon.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty took the Tang and Song systems and fixed nine generations, yet the old temple's eight chambers amount to six generations with zhao and mu undistinguished and father and son seated together—contrary to the Ritual Canon.

sentences.zh: 新廟之制，一十五間，東西二間為夾室，太祖室既居中，則唐、宋之制不可依，惟當以昭穆列之。

translations.literal: The new temple's system has fifteen bays, with two eastern and western bays as flanking chambers; since Taizu's chamber is already at the center, the Tang and Song systems cannot be followed—only arrangement by zhao and mu will do.
translations.idiomatic: The new temple has fifteen bays with two flanking chambers east and west; since Taizu's chamber stands at the center, Tang and Song models cannot be followed—only a zhao-mu arrangement will do.

sentences.zh: 父為昭，子為穆，則睿宗當居太祖之東，為昭之第一世，世祖居西，為穆之第一世。

translations.literal: Father is zhao and son is mu; thus Ruizong should be east of Taizu as the first zhao generation, and Shizu west as the first mu generation.
translations.idiomatic: Father is zhao and son is mu; Ruizong should stand east of Taizu as the first zhao generation, and Shizu west as the first mu generation.

sentences.zh: 裕宗居東，為昭之第二世。

translations.literal: Yuzong should be in the east as the second zhao generation.
translations.idiomatic: Yuzong should stand in the east as the second zhao generation.

sentences.zh: 兄弟共為一世，則成宗、順宗、顯宗三室皆當居西，為穆之第二世。

translations.literal: Brothers count as one generation; thus the three chambers of Chengzong, Shunzong, and Xianzong should all be in the west as the second mu generation.
translations.idiomatic: Brothers count as one generation; Chengzong, Shunzong, and Xianzong should all stand in the west as the second mu generation.

sentences.zh: 武宗、仁宗二室皆當居東，為昭之第三世。

translations.literal: The two chambers of Wuzong and Renzong should both be in the east as the third zhao generation.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzong and Renzong should both stand in the east as the third zhao generation.

sentences.zh: 英宗居西，為穆之第三世。

translations.literal: Yingzong should be in the west as the third mu generation.
translations.idiomatic: Yingzong should stand in the west as the third mu generation.

sentences.zh: 昭之後居左，穆之後居右，西以左為上，東以右為上也。

translations.literal: Those after zhao sit to the left, those after mu to the right; in the west the left is superior, in the east the right is superior.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao descendants sit to the left and mu to the right; in the west the left takes precedence, in the east the right.

sentences.zh: 茍或如此，則昭穆分明，秩然有序，不違《禮經》，可為萬世法。

translations.literal: If it were thus, zhao and mu would be clear, order would be distinct, the Ritual Canon would not be violated, and this could serve as a model for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: If arranged thus, zhao and mu would be clear and order distinct, the Ritual Canon would be honored, and this could serve as a model for ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 若以累朝定制，依室次於新廟遷安，則顯宗躋順宗之上，順宗躋成宗之上。

translations.literal: If one follows the accumulated custom of successive reigns and installs them in the new temple according to chamber order, then Xianzong would be placed above Shunzong, and Shunzong above Chengzong.
translations.idiomatic: If one follows successive reigns' custom and installs them in the new temple by chamber order, Xianzong would rank above Shunzong and Shunzong above Chengzong.

sentences.zh: 以禮言之，春秋閔公無子，庶兄僖公代立，其子文公遂躋僖公於閔公之上，史稱逆祀。

translations.literal: In terms of ritual, in the Spring and Autumn period Duke Min had no son; his younger brother by a concubine, Duke Xi, took the throne in his stead, and Duke Xi's son Duke Wen then placed Duke Xi above Duke Min—the histories call this an inverted sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In ritual terms, in the Spring and Autumn era Duke Min had no son and his younger half-brother Duke Xi succeeded him; Duke Xi's son Duke Wen then ranked Duke Xi above Duke Min—the histories call this an inverted sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 及定公正其序，書曰「從祀先公」。

translations.literal: When Duke Ding corrected the order, the Annals record "followed in sacrificing to the former lord."
translations.idiomatic: When Duke Ding corrected the order, the Annals record that he "followed in sacrificing to the former lord."

sentences.zh: 然僖公猶是有位之君，尚不可居故君之上，況未嘗正位者乎？

translations.literal: Yet Duke Xi was still a lord who had held the throne and could not be placed above the former lord—how much less one who never properly held the throne?
translations.idiomatic: Yet even Duke Xi had actually reigned and could not be placed above the former lord—how much less one who never properly held the throne?

sentences.zh: 國家雖曰以右為尊，然古人所尚，或左或右，初無定制。

translations.literal: The state may say that the right is honored, yet what the ancients esteemed was sometimes left and sometimes right, with no fixed rule at the outset.
translations.idiomatic: The state may honor the right, yet the ancients esteemed sometimes left and sometimes right, with no fixed rule at first.

sentences.zh: 古人右社稷而左宗廟，國家宗廟亦居東方。

translations.literal: The ancients placed the altars of soil and grain to the right and the ancestral temple to the left; our state's ancestral temple also stands in the east.
translations.idiomatic: The ancients placed the altars of soil and grain to the right and the ancestral temple to the left; our ancestral temple likewise stands in the east.

sentences.zh: 豈有建宗廟之方位既依《禮經》，而宗廟之昭穆反不應《禮經》乎？

translations.literal: How can the site of the ancestral temple already follow the Ritual Canon, while the zhao and mu of the ancestral temple run counter to the Ritual Canon?
translations.idiomatic: How can the temple's site follow the Ritual Canon while its zhao-mu arrangement violates it?

sentences.zh: 且如今朝賀或祭祀，宰相獻官分班而立，居西則尚左，居東則尚右。

translations.literal: Moreover, in today's court audiences or sacrifices, chief councillors and presenting officers stand in separate ranks: those in the west honor the left, those in the east honor the right.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, at today's court audiences or sacrifices, chief councillors and presenting officers stand in separate ranks: those in the west honor the left, those in the east the right.

sentences.zh: 及行禮就位，則西者復尚右，東者復尚左矣。

translations.literal: When the rites begin and they take their places, those in the west again honor the right, and those in the east again honor the left.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites begin and they take their places, those in the west again honor the right and those in the east the left.

sentences.zh: 至職居博士，宗廟之事所宜建明，然事大體重，宜從使院移書集議取旨。

translations.literal: As one holding the office of erudite, it is fitting to clarify matters of the ancestral temple; yet the affair is great and weighty, and a dispatch should be sent from the supervising academy to assemble deliberation and seek the imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: As an erudite it is my duty to clarify ancestral temple matters; yet the affair is grave, and the supervising academy should convene deliberation and seek the imperial decision.

sentences.zh: 四月辛巳，中書省臣言：「世祖皇帝始建太廟。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi in the fourth month, a member of the Secretariat said: "Emperor Shizu first built the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the fourth month a Secretariat official reported: "Emperor Shizu first built the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 太祖皇帝居中南向，睿宗、世祖、裕宗神主以次祔西室，順宗、成宗、武宗、仁宗以次祔東室。

translations.literal: Emperor Taizu sat in the center facing south; the spirit tablets of Ruizong, Shizu, and Yuzong were enshrined in order in the western chambers, and those of Shunzong, Chengzong, Wuzong, and Renzong in order in the eastern chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizu stood at the center facing south; the spirit tablets of Ruizong, Shizu, and Yuzong were enshrined in order in the western chambers, and those of Shunzong, Chengzong, Wuzong, and Renzong in the eastern chambers.

sentences.zh: 邇者集賢、翰林、太常諸臣言，國朝建太廟遵古制，古尚左，今尊者居右為少屈，非所以示後世。

translations.literal: Recently ministers of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies, Hanlin Academy, and Court of Imperial Sacrifices said that in building the Imperial Ancestral Temple our dynasty follows the ancient system; antiquity honored the left, yet today the honored sit to the right—a slight compromise—not how one should instruct posterity.
translations.idiomatic: Recently ministers of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies, Hanlin Academy, and Court of Imperial Sacrifices observed that our dynasty's temple follows ancient practice; antiquity honored the left, yet today the honored sit to the right—a slight compromise unworthy of instructing posterity.

sentences.zh: 太祖皇帝居中南向，宜奉睿宗皇帝神主祔左一室，世祖祔右一室，裕宗祔睿宗室之左。

translations.literal: Emperor Taizu sits in the center facing south; Emperor Ruizong's spirit tablet should be enshrined in the chamber to the left, Shizu's in the chamber to the right, and Yuzong to the left of Ruizong's chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizu stands at the center facing south; Emperor Ruizong's tablet should be enshrined in the left chamber, Shizu's in the right, and Yuzong to the left of Ruizong's chamber.

sentences.zh: 顯宗、順宗、成宗兄弟也，以次祔世祖室之右，武宗、仁宗亦兄弟也，以祔裕宗室之左，英宗祔成宗室之右。

translations.literal: Xianzong, Shunzong, and Chengzong were brothers and should be enshrined in order to the right of Shizu's chamber; Wuzong and Renzong were also brothers and should be enshrined to the left of Yuzong's chamber; Yingzong should be enshrined to the right of Chengzong's chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzong, Shunzong, and Chengzong were brothers and should be enshrined in order to the right of Shizu's chamber; Wuzong and Renzong were brothers and should be enshrined to the left of Yuzong's chamber; Yingzong to the right of Chengzong's chamber.

sentences.zh: 臣等以其議近是，謹繪室次為圖以獻，惟陛下裁擇。

translations.literal: We consider their proposal nearly correct and respectfully draw a diagram of the chamber order to present; may Your Majesty decide."
translations.idiomatic: We find their proposal largely correct and respectfully submit a diagram of the chamber order for Your Majesty's decision."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，祔顯宗、英宗凡十室。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu in the fifth month, Xianzong and Yingzong were enshrined—ten chambers in all.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the fifth month Xianzong and Yingzong were enshrined, for ten chambers in all.

sentences.zh: 四年夏四月辛未，盜入太廟，失武宗神位及祭器。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer in the fourth year, on the day xinwei, thieves entered the Imperial Ancestral Temple and the spirit seat of Wuzong and sacrificial vessels were lost.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month of year 4, on the xinwei day, thieves broke into the Imperial Ancestral Temple and stole Wuzong's spirit seat and sacrificial vessels.

sentences.zh: 壬申，重作武宗金主及祭器。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Wuzong's gold spirit tablet and sacrificial vessels were remade.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day Wuzong's gilded spirit tablet and sacrificial vessels were remade.

sentences.zh: 甲午，奉安武宗神主。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Wuzong's spirit tablet was reverently installed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day Wuzong's spirit tablet was reverently installed.

sentences.zh: 天歷元年冬十月丁亥，毀顯宗室。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter in the first year of Tianli, on the day dinghai, Xianzong's chamber was demolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the tenth winter month of Tianli 1, Xianzong's chamber was demolished.

sentences.zh: 重改至元之六年六月，詔毀文宗室。

translations.literal: The text was revised to the sixth month of the sixth year of Zhiyuan, when an edict ordered the demolition of Wenzong's chamber.
translations.idiomatic: The text was revised to the sixth month of Zhiyuan 6, when an edict ordered the demolition of Wenzong's chamber.

sentences.zh: 其宗廟之事，本末因革，大概如此。

translations.literal: Such, in broad outline, are the origins, course, and reforms of affairs concerning the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Such, in broad outline, are the origins, course, and reforms of ancestral temple affairs.

sentences.zh: 凡大祭祀，尤貴馬湩。

translations.literal: In all great sacrifices, mare's milk is especially prized.
translations.idiomatic: In all great sacrifices, mare's milk is especially prized.

sentences.zh: 將有事，敕太僕寺挏馬官，奉尚飲者革囊盛送焉。
